resources.string: Custom drivers (Turnip) only work on Qualcomm Adreno GPUs. This GPU uses the driver that came with the phone; system updates are the way to get a newer one. Emulators still run, using that driver.
Adreno %1$s: Turnip support for 8xx GPUs is new. Use builds marked a8xx, and keep the phone\'s own driver if a game runs worse.
Adreno %1$s: Turnip often runs Switch, PS2, GameCube and PC games better than the phone\'s own driver. If a game breaks, switch back to the system driver in that emulator.
Adreno %1$s is older than Turnip supports (Adreno 6xx and newer).
The GPU model could not be read on this device.
DroidDeck needs a Qualcomm Adreno GPU, and this device does not have one.
Adreno %1$s has been tested but is below the official 730 minimum.
Adreno 6xx is experimental: DirectX 11 games may run, DirectX 12 games may crash.
Adreno %1$s is older than the PC runtime supports.
